cards.ex: His compulsive behavior around gambling was destroying his life.
cards.exUz: Uning qimor o'yinlariga bo'lgan majburiy xulqi hayotini buzayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi, nazorat qilish qiyin bo'lgan harakatlar, odatda stressni kamaytirish uchun.

cards.ex: Nicotine is a highly habit-forming substance.
cards.exUz: Nikotin juda tez odatga aylanadigan modda.
cards.uzDef: Tezda odatga aylanib qoladigan narsa (masalan, modda yoki harakat).

cards.ex: Her dependent personality made it difficult for her to live alone.
cards.exUz: Uning qaram shaxsiyati yolg'iz yashashini qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga kuchli bog'liqlik va qaror qabul qila olmaslik bilan tavsiflangan shaxsiyat.

cards.ex: For him, video games were a means of escape from his stressful job.
cards.exUz: U uchun video o'yinlar stressli ishidan qochish vositasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolardan yoki haqiqatdan qochishning bir usuli.

cards.ex: Overeating became her way of self-soothing when she felt anxious.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari ovqatlanish uning xavotirda bo'lganida o'zini tinchlantirish usuliga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tinchlantirish yoki stressni kamaytirish harakatlari.

cards.ex: He would often indulge in alcohol after a long day at work.
cards.exUz: U ko'pincha ishdan keyin spirtli ichimliklarga berilib ketardi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizga yoqadigan narsaga haddan tashqari berilish.

cards.ex: Driving under the influence is a serious offense.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimliklar ta'sirida mashina haydash jiddiy jinoyatdir.
cards.uzDef: Spirtli ichimlik yoki giyohvand moddalar ta'sirida bo'lish.

cards.ex: It took months, but eventually, she started to lose the urge to smoke.
cards.exUz: Bir necha oy kerak bo'ldi, lekin oxir-oqibat u chekish istagini yo'qota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga bo'lgan kuchli xohishni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: After losing his job, his life took a downward plunge.
cards.exUz: Ishini yo'qotgandan so'ng, uning hayoti pastga qulashni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tez va yomon tomonga o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: Many people struggle to cope with the stress of modern life.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar zamonaviy hayotning stressiga dosh berish uchun kurashadilar.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga dosh berishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His drinking was pushing boundaries and affecting his health.
cards.exUz: Uning ichkilikbozligi chegaralarni surib, sog'lig'iga ta'sir qilayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan chegaralardan o'tishga urinish.

cards.ex: Procrastination is a form of self-defeating behavior.
cards.exUz: Kechiktirish - bu o'zini mag'lub etuvchi xulqning bir shakli.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadlariga erishishga xalaqit beradigan xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: She used shopping as a crutch to lean on when she felt down.
cards.exUz: U tushkunlikka tushganida xarid qilishni suyanchiq sifatida ishlatardi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarda yordam beradigan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: He sometimes gives way to anger when he's under pressure.
cards.exUz: U ba'zan bosim ostida bo'lganida g'azabga yo'l qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ulari yoki istaklarini nazorat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: The habitual offender was sentenced to a longer prison term.
cards.exUz: Odatdagi huquqbuzar uzoqroq muddatga qamoqqa hukm qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni qayta-qayta buzadigan odam.

cards.ex: She needs to get a handle on her spending habits.
cards.exUz: U xarajat odatlarini nazoratga olishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish va nazorat qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: Many young people fall prey to online gambling addiction.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yoshlar onlayn qimor o'yinlariga qurbon bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsaning qurboni bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was too dependent on others to make decisions for himself.
cards.exUz: U o'zi uchun qaror qabul qilish uchun boshqalarga juda qaram edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlarga muhtoj bo'lish.

cards.ex: Experimenting with drugs can be a slippery path to addiction.
cards.exUz: Giyohvand moddalar bilan tajriba o'tkazish giyohvandlikka sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: He felt like he was losing his grip on reality.
cards.exUz: U o'zini haqiqat ustidan nazoratini yo'qotayotgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nazoratni yo'qotish, vaziyatni boshqara olmaslik.

cards.ex: Binge drinking is a serious health risk.
cards.exUz: Ko'p miqdorda ichish jiddiy sog'liq uchun xavfdir.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida ko'p miqdorda spirtli ichimlik iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: Her constant need for attention stemmed from a deep craving for validation.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy e'tiborga bo'lgan ehtiyoji chuqur tasdiqlashga intilishdan kelib chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning ma'qullashini yoki tan olinishini xohlash.

cards.ex: Many people get hooked on social media without realizing it.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar bilmasdan ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga ilakishib qolishadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qaram bo'lib qolmoq, o'rganib qolmoq.

cards.ex: The stress of his job was beginning to take its toll on his health.
cards.exUz: Uning ishidagi stress uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qila boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: For some, food becomes a source of comfort during stressful times.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar uchun oziq-ovqat stressli paytlarda tasalli manbai bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda tasalli beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: His belief that he would fail became a self-fulfilling prophecy.
cards.exUz: Uning muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashiga ishonchi o'zini amalga oshiruvchi bashoratga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Agar odam bunga ishonsa, haqiqatga aylanishi mumkin bo'lgan bashorat.

cards.ex: For her, reading novels was a form of escapism.
cards.exUz: U uchun roman o'qish qochish shakli edi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatdan qochish uchun ishlatiladigan usul.

cards.ex: He needed to break free from his destructive patterns of behavior.
cards.exUz: U o'zining buzuvchi xatti-harakatlaridan xalos bo'lishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy natijalarga olib keladigan takrorlanuvchi xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: He's been on the wagon for six months now.
cards.exUz: U olti oydan beri ichmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Spirtli ichimliklar ichishni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: The relapse rate for heroin addiction is quite high.
cards.exUz: Geroin giyohvandligining qaytalanish darajasi juda yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Davolanishdan keyin qayta giyohvandlikka qaytish darajasi.
